(Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンクイズパズルランド　ピカチュウは{{ruby|名|めい}}たんてい}}''' ''Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu is a Famous Detective'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] composed by [[Hiroshi Takase]] and illustrated by [[Yumiko Sudo]]. It was serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' magazine from the May 2005 issue (released on March 25, 2005) to the June 2015 issue (released on April 21, 2015). The manga utilizes quizzes and puzzles as a method of storytelling.

Two volumes were released under the '''{{j|てんとう虫コミックススペシャル}}''' ''Tentōmusi Comics Special'' label from 2008 to 2009 and two volumes were released under the '''{{j|Big Korotan}}''' label from 2013 to 2015. The first two volumes center around {{p|Pikachu}} and his team of [[Hoenn first partner Pokémon]] versus a team of {{p|Smoochum}}, {{p|Cleffa}}, and {{p|Igglybuff}}, with {{p|Meowth}} also appearing frequently. The final two volumes shift focus between [[Sinnoh first partner Pokémon|Sinnoh]], [[Johto first partner Pokémon|Johto]], [[Unova first partner Pokémon|Unova]], and [[Kalos first partner Pokémon]] along with Pikachu.
